GPT Image 2Using the uploaded YouArt logo as the brand reference, create a photorealistic architectural photograph of a boutique clothing store’s exterior sign. Scene and composition: A horizontal rectangular matte-black metal sign projects perpendicularly from a light beige-gray stone wall on the right, attached by two black metal brackets. Photograph it from the front-left at a slightly low angle, showing the sign’s front face and a narrow strip of its left edge with realistic thickness and natural perspective. Center the sign prominently, occupying approximately two-thirds of the frame, fully visible without cropping. Branding: Place the white YouArt logo from the reference image in the center of the black sign. Faithfully preserve its original symbol, letterforms, typography, capitalization, spacing, and proportions. The distinctive white symbol on the left IS the initial “Y” in “YouArt.” Do not add another Y or repeat the full word beside the symbol. Below the logo, add the exact text “WEAR YOUR STYLE” in small white uppercase sans-serif letters, with wide letter spacing, centered beneath the logo. Render the logo and tagline as thin white acrylic signage with subtle physical depth and realistic contact shadows. Background and lighting: Behind the sign, show the boutique’s glass storefront with dark metal window frames. Through the windows, reveal softly blurred clothing racks and warm golden interior lighting. The storefront occupies the left side, while the stone wall occupies the right. Use soft natural daylight with a gentle contrast between the cooler exterior and the warm interior. Keep the sign and lettering sharp, with a slightly out-of-focus background. Visual style: Refined, understated commercial photography, realistic materials, accurate perspective, and natural shadows. Landscape composition, 4:3 aspect ratio, edge-to-edge image with no border or rounded corners. Do not redesign the logo, substitute its typeface, misspell any letters, or add extra text, brands, watermarks, or people. Avoid neon glow, exaggerated extrusion, and an artificial CGI appearance.

GPT Image 2画布与纸张：垂直3:5比例手机海报，全画幅复古陈旧米色纸张纹理，背景保留约75%留白。视觉中心位于左下象限，上方大面积留空。 主体锚点：核心视觉是主体树木与橙色晚霞的撕纸剪报片段（参考@Image1），具有低对比度、复印件的柔和边缘，呈现出存档胶片感。 字体与色彩：左侧垂直排版微缩文字“Evening Whisper 18:30”。加入一个鲜艳的高饱和度番茄红（tomato-red）不规则色块作为视觉重心，色彩占据整体约2.5%。 氛围与质感：带有Risograph孔版印刷的粗颗粒感和墨迹渗透效果，整体呈现宁静、怀旧的诗意氛围。严禁全屏构图、3D渲染和高对比度阴影。
